description: Browse the Babelii Marketplace, where other vendors sell hotspot vouchers, food, services and goods (the same listings as the /marketplace page). Use it when the buyer asks what the marketplace has or names a vendor or a kind of item (for example "makanan", "voucher hotspot", "jasa"); an empty query lists a sample. Read only: stocked hotspot vouchers are ordered like any product (search_products then prepare_purchase), every other listing is bought on its buy_url page, so give the buyer that link. Rows with sold_out=true are real vendor products whose stock is empty right now. The result also carries buy_requests: open requests where buyers say what they are LOOKING FOR (title, kind, quantity, budget, link; never buyer names or contacts). "Barang yang sedang dicari" means buy_requests, not the vendor listings. Each listing has order_via, which says how to buy it: 'search_products ...' means a stocked voucher you can order through search_products (search its title) then prepare_purchase, or the buyer can use buy_url; 'buy_url ...' means only the buy_url page (give the link, do not try prepare_purchase). buy_requests are buyers' wishes that vendors can answer at buy_requests_url, NOT things for sale, so never offer to buy one.
name: search_marketplace
title: Cari di marketplace
